articles.summary: QueryPie has developed QEV, a decision-making AI model that achieved a 99.69% sensitive data detection rate in an internal DLP evaluation, reducing missed detections by approximately 91.3% compared with a commercial AI model. INT8 quantization reduced GPU memory usage by up to 45.2% across the QEV model family while broadly maintaining detection performance.
articles.title: QueryPie Develops QEV Decision-Making AI Model, Achieving 99.69% Sensitive Data Detection

articles.summary: QueryPie will provide Kakao with its Access Control Platform and technical support. The platform centralizes access policies, approval workflows, and activity records for audits.
articles.title: QueryPie signs agreement to supply its Access Control Platform to Kakao
